notes: Two distinct article treatments in one verse, and both follow rule 29's count-the-the's test: דֶּרֶךְ הַגּוֹיִם → 'the way of the nations' writes a 'the' before each word, so the article takes the one before 'nations' and the construct a supplied one; אֹתוֹת הַשָּׁמַיִם → 'the signs of heaven' renders the rectum anarthrously, so the article's single 'the' is genuinely fronted before the construct.
אֶל is unrepresented because the ASV writes 'Learn not the way' with a bare object, leaving the preposition nothing (rule 40).
